faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow post at AIIMS Guwahati is 29 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Guwahati Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow post in the AIIMS Guwahati recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for AIIMS Guwahati Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow positions at AIIMS Guwahati is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send the application form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow at AIIMS Guwahati?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow post is 32 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for AIIMS Guwahati Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology or Social Work from a recognized Indian university/institute with at least 55% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: For Project Associate, the salary is Rs. 30,000/- + 20% HRA, and for JRF, it is Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Guwahati Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow recruitment at AIIMS Guwahati.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow posts at AIIMS Guwahati includes an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate-I/Junior Research Fellow position is Guwahati, Assam, specifically at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Guwahati.
